info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Historical Report Data - Trades API

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of entries to skip from the beginning of the collection

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: Specifies an entity id to start retrieving entries from. This is normally only used in generated nextlinks.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of entries to return from the beginning of the collection

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: The key of the account group to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The key of the account to which the resource belongs.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: The key of the client to which the resource belongs.

params.name: FromDate
params.description: from date in UTC, ignored when tradeId is given

params.name: ToDate
params.description: to date in UTC, ignored when tradeId is given

params.name: TradeId
params.description: trade id, accountkey is mandatory with tradeId

items.docs: Gets all trades for dates or tradeId.
